maps.name: AlphaN - TPS
maps.notes: AlphaN - TPS If there is a DTC 12 (TPS) then "AlphaN - TPS (DTC 12)" else "AlphaN - TPS" [ ["AlphaN - IACV" x "AlphaN - IACV (TPS Compensation)"] + ["AlphaN - TPS"] ] x "AlphaN - IAT Compensation" This results in a calculated Load (and Airflow) value that is used throughout the rest of the code. AlphaN should never be used with a Forced Induction engine.

maps.name: Dashpot - Nominal
maps.notes: IP_ISAPWM_DHP_(AT)__N_32__TPS - The Dashpot function acts like a Throttle lever damper on a carbureted engine. It is used when closing the Throttle to promote smooth torque reduction. It may need to be adjusted for large diameter Throttle bodies because even a small change in Throttle can result in a large percentage difference in airflow, especially at low Throttle angles. The values in this table are immediately applied when they are increasing but are only allowed to decrease gradually using "Dashpot - Change Limitation".

maps.name: Fuel Injection - Base
maps.notes: This table contains the Injector Pulse Width (in milliseconds) needed to get an AFR of 14.7 at a given Load and Engine Speed. Adjust this by a percentage of injector difference from stock as a baseline. Tune a needed.

maps.name: Fuel Injection - Base - VANOS Correction
maps.notes: This table modifies Fuel Injector Pulsewidth when VANOS is active. The values in this map are mutliplied to the measured VANOS angle and added or subtracted to "Fuel Injection - Base".

maps.name: Ignition Timing - Base
maps.notes: This is the main ignition timing advance map.

maps.name: Ignition Timing - Anti-Jerk
maps.notes: This is the main Anti-Jerk map.

maps.name: Ignition Retard - ASC
maps.notes: NEEDS TESTING - This table retards Ignition Timing if requested by the ASC module.

maps.name: Ignition Timing - Base - ECT/IAT Compensation - Nominal
maps.notes: IP_IGA_N_MAF__N_32__MAF - This is multiplied to the "Ignition Timing - Base - ECT/IAT Compensation - Multiplicative" table to determine total adjustment to ignition angle based on coolant and air temperature.

maps.name: Ignition Timing - Base - VANOS Correction
maps.notes: This table modifies Ignition Timing when VANOS is active. The values in this map are mutliplied to the measured VANOS angle and added or subtracted to "Ignition Timing - Base".

maps.name: Muffler Flap Solenoid
maps.notes: This tables defines when the muffler flap is opened. If the values in this table exceed current TPS% at a given Coolant Temp and RPM, the muffler flap solenoid opens. Set this entire table to 0 if the muffler flap should be open at all times.

maps.name: VANOS - Min. Load (Light Throttle) (AT)
maps.notes: During "Light Throttle" if Load is greater than the values in this table, VANOS will be activated. This table is for Automatic Transmission cars.

maps.name: VANOS - Min. Load (Light Throttle) (MT)
maps.notes: During "Light Throttle" at a particular Engine Speed and Coolant Temperature if Load is greater than the values in this table, VANOS will be activated. This table is for Manual Transmission cars.

maps.name: Fuel Enrichment - Increasing Load - Initial
maps.notes: The "Fuel Enrichment - Increasing Load" (FEIL) tables are used to add additional fuel when Load is increasing. If MAF is tuned to represent the correct real world Load, these tables may not need to be modified if using the stock intake manifold while Normally Aspirated. During a 'First Trigger', this table is multiplied only to "FEIL Nominal". Also, a hidden variable, 'FEIL Session Numerator' is set to 0 which increments by 1 every ECU cycle. During a 'Re-Trigger', the value from this table when a 'First Trigger' was recently initiated is multiplied to both "FEIL Nominal" and one of the "FEIL Reduction Gradient" tables.

maps.name: Fuel Enrichment - Increasing TPS
maps.notes: The "Fuel Enrichment - Increasing TPS" (FEIT) tables are used to add additional fuel when TPS is increasing. Used in two scenarios; 'First Triggering' and 'New Triggering'. During 'First Triggering' this table is multiplied to "Fuel Enrichment - Increasing TPS - Initial". During 'New Triggering', it is multiplied to the original value of "Fuel Enrichment - Increasing TPS - Initial" used during 'First Triggering' of the current Throttle acceleration enrichment session.

maps.name: Fuel Enrichment - Increasing Load - Nominal
maps.notes: During a 'First Trigger', this table is multiplied only to "FEIL Initial". During a 'Re-Trigger', this table is multiplied to both "FEIL Initial" and one of the "FEIL Reduction Gradient" tables. 'Load Ratio' is the Load when FEIL was first triggered divided by the current Load.

maps.name: Fuel Enleanment - Decreasing TPS - Multiplicative
maps.notes: IP_TI_FAC_TRA_PUR(_AT)__MAF_RATIO_PUR__TCO - This table is used during both FT and NT events. See "Fuel Enleanment - Decreasing TPS" for description. 'Load Ratio' is the current Load divided by the Load when Fuel Enleanment was first triggered.

maps.name: CH - Fuel Enrichment - Additive
maps.notes: Add the values in this table after multiplying "CH - Fuel Enrichment - Nominal" to either "CH - Fuel Enrichment - Multiplicative (Idle)" or "CH - Fuel Enrichment - Multiplicative (above Idle)" to calculate Fuel Enrichment % when the Catalyst Heating function is enabled.

maps.name: Fuel Enleanment - Decreasing TPS
maps.notes: IP_TI_FAC_PUR(_AT)__N_32__MAF - During a FT event, this table is multiplied to the "Fuel Enleanment - Decreasing TPS - Multiplicative" table to determine Fuel Enleanment when Throttle is decreasing. However, during a NT event, the value used during the last FT event is multiplied to the "Fuel Enleanment - Decreasing TPS - Multiplicative" table which is then multiplied to the "Fuel Enleanment - Deactivation Factor" table.

maps.name: CH - Fuel Enrichment - Nominal
maps.notes: Multiply this table to "CH - Fuel Enrichment - Multiplicative (Idle)" or "CH - Fuel Enrichment - Multiplicative (above Idle)" and add "CH - Fuel Enrichment - Additive" to calculate Fuel Enrichment % when the Catalyst Heating function is enabled.

maps.name: Fuel Injection - Warmup Enrichment (ECT Compensation)
maps.notes: Fuel enrichment for a cold engine. Multiply the values in this table to "Fuel Injection - Warmup Enrichment" to calculate final Warmup Enrichment

maps.name: Fuel Injection - Warmup Enrichment
maps.notes: Fuel enrichment for a cold engine. Multiply the values in this table to "Fuel Injection - Warmup Enrichment (ECT Compensation)" to calculate Warmup Enrichment.

maps.name: Fuel Enrichment - Increasing Load - Initial Session Denominator
maps.notes: Initialized only during a 'First Trigger'. 'FEIL Session Numerator' is set to 0 which increments by 1 every ECU cycle. If (1 - 'FEIL Session Numerator' / "FEIL Initial Session Denominator" is less than "FEIL Re-Trigger Duration", a 'First Trigger' is possible if Load is increasing.

maps.name: Fuel Enleanment - Decreasing TPS - Session Duration
maps.notes: IP_TI_CYCNR_PUR(_AT)__N_32__TCO - This table is used to set the "Session Duration Counter" during a FT event and determines the duration of each "Fuel Enleanment - Decreasing TPS" session. This Counter decrements every ECU cycle and after it reaches 0, if Decreasing TPS occurs again, it will be considered a FT event.

maps.name: Ignition Retard - Decreasing TPS - Step Size
maps.notes: IP_IGA_LGRD_PU(_AT)__N_32__MAF_MMV - "Ignition Retard - Decreasing TPS - Step Size" and "Ignition Retard - Decreasing TPS - Step Size (ECT Compensation)" are added together to determine how gradually Ignition Timing is allowed to decrease when Throttle is slowly reduced. This is used during both "Ignition Retard - Decreasing TPS" and "Ignition Retard - Decreasing TPS (Closed)" but not "Ignition Retard - Fast Decreasing TPS (Closed)". A larger 'step size' will result in a faster change to applied Ignition Timing.

maps.name: Ignition Retard - Decreasing TPS
maps.notes: IP_IGA_PU(_AT)__N__TCO - Ignition Timing is gradually reduced by this table when Throttle is decreasing, or when Throttle is closed and Engine Speed is less than the sum of "Fuel Restore - RPM" and "Fuel Cut - RPM Hysteresis" tables.

maps.name: Detection - Increasing TPS
maps.notes: ID_TPS_GRD_BOL_AE(_AT)__N_32__TPS - If the Throttle is increasing faster than the sum of "Detection - Increasing TPS" and "Detection - Increasing TPS (ECT Compensation)" then Acceleration tables are used.

maps.name: Detection - Decreasing TPS
maps.notes: ID_TPS_GRD_BOL_PUR(_AT)__N_32__TPS - If Throttle is decreasing faster than the sum of "Detection - Decreasing TPS" and "Detection - Decreasing TPS (ECT Compensation)" then Deceleration tables are used.

maps.name: VANOS - On/Off (Heavy Throttle) (AT)
maps.notes: During "Heavy Throttle" at a particular Engine Speed and Vehicle Speed if the value in this table is 1, VANOS will be activated. This table is for Automatic Transmission cars.

maps.name: VANOS - On/Off (Heavy Throttle) (MT)
maps.notes: During "Heavy Throttle" at a particular Engine Speed and Vehicle Speed if the value in this table is 1, VANOS will be activated. This table is for Manual Transmission cars. Only use this table to edit RPM axis.

maps.name: Ignition Retard - Fast Increasing TPS
maps.notes: ID_IGA_TRA_KNK(_AT)__N_32__MAF - This table determines how much to retard the Ignition Timing when the Throttle is opened quickly. This table is used to prevent knock when the Throttle is opened quickly.

maps.name: Adaptation Multiplicative - Warm-up Compensation

maps.name: COP - Fuel Enrichment - Nominal
maps.notes: IP_TI_COP__N_32__MAF - This table is added to "COP - Fuel Enrichment - Additive" to determine final Fuel Enrichment due to COP. The code will not allow any negative Fuel Enrichment so setting this table to all 0 will disable all Catalyst Overheating Protection. Only do this if there is no Catalytic Converter present.

maps.name: MAF
maps.notes: This is the scaling for the MAF sensor when the stock MAF Mode = 1024 kg/hr just in a convenient 16x16 format for easier editing. If another MAF table for a higher 2048 kg/hr table is shown below, then editing this table will not result in changes being saved. Only the last MAF table displayed will save changes. You have two options at this point. Either edit and reflash the 256KB version which allows setting the MAF Mode to 2048kg/hr, or know the values displayed in the 2048kg/hr table are artificially multiplied by 2 compared to actual if in stock 1024kg/hr mode. Please see the forums for more assistance if needed.
